name: Empanada Kitchen
notes: 3 photos: 1.jpg and 3.jpg are the same printed clipboard menu (merged, no duplicates); 2.jpg shows an unrelated business's digital menu board (Ferlini Coffee) and was skipped as not this restaurant's menu.

dishes.name: Beef
dishes.description: Ground beef, onion, red bell pepper, green onion, olives. The most traditional filling. Not ideal for vegetarians.

dishes.name: Ham & Cheese
dishes.description: Only two ingredients, but a lot of flavor.

dishes.name: Ratatouille aka Veggie
dishes.description: Roasted veggies, onion, red bell pepper, eggplant, zucchini, tomato, garlic. Also, this one is vegan.

dishes.name: Chicken
dishes.description: We cook the chicken, we make a sofrito and then we sauté all together. Be careful, it's very juicy.

dishes.name: Sweet Corn & Basil
dishes.description: Sweet corn, basil, and mozzarella, all integrated in a delicious béchamel sauce.

dishes.name: Mushroom & Goat Cheese
dishes.description: Sauteed onions, sauteed mushrooms, goat cheese and a touch of mozzarella.

dishes.name: Caprese
dishes.description: Traditional caprese combination. Basil, tomato and mozzarella.

dishes.name: Bacon & Egg
dishes.description: Our American take on the Argentine style empanada. Only for breakfast, or special request.

dishes.name: Lamb
dishes.description: Lamb leg braised for 24 hours in onions, rosemary and red wine.
